h_recipe_french_longer: When asked to translate a recipe into French, the model systematically produces a longer response (higher word count) than when translating the same recipe into English.
h_negation_in_math: The model frequently fails simple word problems when constraints are phrased using negative framing (e.g. 'none of the following except').
h_over_refusal_medical: The model gives boilerplate safety refusals when asked objective, non-diagnostic medical definition questions (e.g. asking for the biochemical mechanism of ibuprofen).
h_spatial_left_right: The model struggles with spatial relative orientation tasks (e.g. determining which object is to the left/right from the perspective of an inverted observer).
h_calendar_weekday_calculation: The model hallucinates the day of the week for dates in the future or past that require calculating leap years.
